notes: Beach: the figure is far bigger and much farther out, dozens of long worms writhe up from its head and its raised hand's fingers are worms reaching on toward the sun. Worm room: more, longer worms that jerk, ripple and throb fast. Spider nest: new reddish-brown spiders whose legs never stop moving and who creep forward and back; webs are real threads in 3D with dew.
